interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to encourage slower vehicle speeds and reduce the total crossing distance.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Extend the paved sidewalk through the foreground to provide a continuous, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight.

interventions.title: Daylighting the Intersection
interventions.description: Relocate or shield the utility box to improve visibility at the crossing point.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Pave the Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Pave the dirt area between the curb and sidewalk to provide a stable, all-weather surface for people entering or exiting parked vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility 'continental' markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (HAWK)
interventions.description: Install a signalized crossing to allow pedestrians to stop traffic on this high-speed arterial.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalks on both sides of the arterial to provide basic pedestrian safety and mobility.

interventions.title: Protected Pedestrian Crossings
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks with pedestrian signals and refuge islands to facilitate safe crossing of the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the number or width of travel lanes to slow traffic and repurpose space for pedestrian and bicycle infrastructure.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to ensure the walkway is well-illuminated for nighttime safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearance
interventions.description: Ensure the sidewalk remains clear of garden debris and encroachment from adjacent residential landscaping.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings and signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Activated Signal
interventions.description: Install a Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB) or Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon to alert drivers to crossing pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks at regular intervals or at the distant intersection to provide legal and visible crossing points.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing/Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number or width of travel lanes to slow traffic and reduce the crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Regular trimming of grass and removal of weeds to ensure the full width of the sidewalk remains clear and accessible.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Installation of street lighting to improve visibility and personal security for pedestrians during nighttime.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install marked crossings with signalization at appropriate intervals to allow safe access across the arterial to commercial areas.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of through lanes or narrow existing lanes to slow traffic and provide space for other modes.

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island in the median to break up the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Buffered Bike Lane
interventions.description: Convert excess roadway width into a buffered bike lane to further separate pedestrians from moving traffic and narrow the perceived road width.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility patterns to provide a designated and safer crossing point for residents.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Infrastructure
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks, pedestrian refuge islands in the median, and HAWK signals or full traffic signals to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes or narrow them to lower vehicle speeds and reduce the crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: ADA-compliant curb ramps
interventions.description: Ensure all crossing points have tactile, sloped curb ramps to provide accessibility for all users.
